digest.component_or_area: op-cert storage and producer (SIGNATURE event extension)
propositions: An op-cert DSSE envelope must be stored on a ticket by extending the existing SIGNATURE event record (not introducing a new event type), carrying the encoded envelope, material_fingerprint, and merged_log_commit as present-only fields alongside the manifest and algorithm='sshsig'.

The reducer process_signature must preserve envelope, material_fingerprint, and merged_log_commit from SIGNATURE events into the attestations[kind] record, and the compaction fold must restore attestations verbatim so op-cert fields survive round-trip compaction unchanged.

A read helper opcert.opcert_from_record must return (envelope, bound_fields) for op-cert records and None for legacy HMAC records, enabling downstream callers (4214 merge-gate verify, ee0b trusted-server producer) to distinguish and handle each type.
Legacy HMAC sign_manifest records must remain byte-unchanged (no envelope or bound keys added) and continue to HMAC-verify, ensuring additive schema evolution does not alter existing attestations.

Op-cert SIGNATURE events are preserved append-only by pre-upgrade clones but read as unsigned (lacking asymmetric verifier), requiring verify/reconcile hosts to upgrade first before op-cert events can be verified (rollout posture mirrors SSHSIG authorship and TAG_DELTA precedents).
